newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backeds flat in very light trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backeds flat in very light trade.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities were virtually flat on a very quiet Wednesday, traders said.
"Starting this morning, the market still had a buy-dips mentality, said one trader. "They are trying to figure out where is the dip ... and where is a good place to buy."
Another trader said pass-through activity was a continuation of Tuesday.
"Mortgage price spreads continued to collapse just as people continued to reprice their portfolios." he said.
By late afternoon, 30-year pass-throughs generally were flat to 1/32 lower.

Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent coupons were off 1/32 to 100-09/32 and were yielding 111 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note. Comparable Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac paper was off 1/32 as well, at 100-05/32 and 100-10/32, respectively.
The 10-year note was down 4/32 at 100-24/32, yielding 6.40 percent.
Reports on personal income and spending and the Chicago purchasing managers index (PMI) are scheduled for release on Thursday.
